scope: New generated diffuse derivatives of CC0 tee and trousers; explicitly retains their original cut. Does not claim material replacement fixes anatomy, tailoring or animation. Earlier layers candidate remains art-failed.

mode_inference_decision.rationale: Opaque diffuse edits on existing 3D UV islands; source alpha and image layout remain fixed; no UI keying.

generation.resolution_alignment: 1254 square generated RGB aligned to source 2048; maximum 2x upscale guard; budget diffuse finally 1024. Upscaling is not new detail.

alpha_policy: Retain original encoded alpha per texel. Generated RGB is composited only inside actual mesh UV footprint plus bounded texture padding; unused atlas pixels remain source. Opaque output is intentional, not a cutout.
allowed_operations: size alignment to original 2048 square if aspect ratio exact
deterministic UV footprint mask with 8px dilation
existing linear-light and normalized-normal texture optimizer
invariants: all scene/skin/material/sampler JSON exact except storage offsets
all other embedded images exact before optimization
source image alpha exact before optimization
no new draw calls, vertices, meshes or materials
qa_gates: generated image square and RGB/RGBA finite 8-bit channels
target diffuse alpha equal to source
unselected atlas pixels byte-exact after deterministic composition
compare original UV mapped 9-view GLB including arm and ankle probes
no sports logo/orange band retained on used shirt UV
no new visible atlas seams, painted hardware or baked-light conflict
no new tailoring or whole-CS2-quality claim
optimized result <=20,000,000 bytes, all non-image payloads exact and existing MASK gates pass
known_limits: Tee remains short sleeved and trousers retain original civilian cut.
Material-only candidate, broad animation and in-game skinned performance are unverified.
Generated layout must be visually checked; mechanical source-UV preservation cannot prove painted seam alignment.
Budget stage resizes original normal maps with vector renormalization; only full stage preserves their original bytes. No new normal or roughness texture was generated.
approval_scope: fabric-only candidate assembly, not full character or runtime
